items.headline: Orca Merges With Loopscale to Fund AI & Robotics
items.summary: Solana DEX $ORCA is merging with Loopscale to form 'Formation', a new DeFi venture targeting financing for AI, energy, robotics and defense.

items.headline: $ASTRO Kills Tokenholder Governance, Emissions Hit Zero
items.summary: Astroport is ending tokenholder governance on Neutron and Terra. $ASTRO emissions drop to zero as contributors take over via DAO DAO orgs.

items.headline: $APT Reaffirms 210M Token Lock as Unlocks Wind Down
items.summary: Aptos doubled down on its 210 million $APT lock as the insider unlock cycle nears its end, with a 2.6% staking rate and higher gas fees already live.

items.headline: $ZK Opens Prividium Code, Bundesbank Testing It
items.summary: ZKsync open-sourced its Prividium enterprise privacy stack under Apache 2.0 — and Matter Labs says the Bundesbank is already testing a self-hosted deployment.

items.headline: Moody's Rates $SKY B3 in First Stablecoin Protocol Grade
items.summary: Moody's gave Sky Protocol a B3 rating — its first ever for a stablecoin protocol — flagging a thin ~$90M capital buffer against $10B in assets as $USDS institutional demand grows.
